description: This file contains unit tests for tenantClient utility functions such as normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant. It uses Jest for mocking and testing asynchronous behavior related to tenant management.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID inputs into a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches session tenants from the server and returns an array of tenant objects.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates local storage, and communicates with server.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant ID in local storage, replacing legacy key.
